reason: The current GraphRecommender achieves macro validation HR@10 of 0.6213, but its attention query depends only on the graph-user vector despite contextualized history keys and values. Historical successes support testing explicit sequential intent, while the previous convolution's slight regression from 0.6225 and failed objective changes favor a narrowly scoped query modification. Modify model_design for this hypothesis and training_evaluation for faithful serialization and verification; Electronics HR@10 of 0.465 motivates the experiment without establishing its cause.

plan.model_design: Add history_last_query = nn.Linear(dim, dim, bias=False) to GraphRecommender and zero-initialize its weights so the new branch initially preserves the existing attention query. In encode_history, gather the last valid contextualized vector from values using the greatest position where mask is true, explicitly zero it for empty histories, and compute query = (self.history_query(u) + self.history_last_query(last_value)).unsqueeze(1) before the existing tanh attention scoring. This conditions retrieval on recent intent within the same jointly trained network, including unknown users with nonempty histories, without introducing another scorer. Preserve existing variable names and method signatures, adding only an optional constructor argument if needed to identify the updated architecture, and retain empty-history returns and padding semantics. Keep graph propagation, supervised-edge masking, residual causal convolution, relative positions, fusion gate, tied item vectors, jointly learned item bias, loss, optimizer, and regularization unchanged.
plan.training_evaluation: Update architecture_version consistently in GraphRecommender, train_category metadata, and write_predictor() so working/predict.py reconstructs the added projection and strictly loads its parameters while preserving predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None) and all four dataset routes. Extend check_history_fusion within its existing RNG-preserving scope to verify finite empty, singleton, and padded outputs, correct last-valid selection, zero empty-history contribution, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity; test nonzero projection gradients using a history with multiple distinct events because singleton attention has no query-dependent pooling gradient. Explicitly retain supplied splits and preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, evaluation seed=42, SequenceCuts prefix sampling, HISTORY_LEN=128, negative sampling, batch size, steps, optimizer, regularization, EPOCHS default 200, patience, category time limits, and checkpoint-selection rules. Train one independent model from scratch and select exactly one checkpoint for each of Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl on one GPU, retaining DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and trial-local artifacts without ensembles, checkpoint averaging, auxiliary fitted scorers, hidden-test access, or other-trial checkpoint reuse. Report actual selected-checkpoint local validation metrics, correct the printed comparison reference to the current 0.6213, and accept the hypothesized 0.005–0.015 absolute macro gain only if independently measured by the unchanged pinned host evaluator using 200 validation users per category and 99 unique negatives.
